title: Math: Ordinal Numbers 1st to 20th 🔢
summary:
1. What are Ordinal Numbers?
They tell us the position or order of something. (Examples: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th).

2. Spelling the Tricky Ones:
• 1st = First, 2nd = Second, 3rd = Third.
• 5th = Fifth (not fiveth).
• 8th = Eighth (only one 't').
• 9th = Ninth (no 'e').
• 12th = Twelfth (has an 'f').
• 20th = Twentieth.

3. Front and End (Left and Right):
We can count positions from the front (left) or from the end (right).
For example, if there are 20 fruits in a line, the 1st from the left is the same as the 20th from the right!
